capabilities: Build a dependency graph of concepts and materials from notes, pasted lists, or existing note links
Route learning steps toward one or more goals with deadlines, pace and time estimates
Mark concepts and materials as learning, mastered, known or done
Schedule spaced review of mastered concepts with FSRS and run self-checks from question callouts
Export the map to Obsidian Canvas or SVG
disambiguation: Not a vault link-graph viewer; the map is a manually built prerequisite graph with route, progress and review, not a picture of existing links.
extras: Requires Obsidian 1.13.0 or later and updating on every device that shares the vault. Optional demo vaults are offered for download. All data lives in note properties and local files; the plugin makes no network requests. Node positions cannot be dragged, and large maps take noticeable time to lay out.
problem: Obsidian can link notes but offers no way to order them into a prerequisite-based learning path with progress marks, time estimates and scheduled review.

relations.evidence: the commands Export map to Canvas and Export map as SVG, save the map as it is drawn now
Review is scheduled by FSRS (ts-fsrs, MIT)
Install BRAT, run BRAT: Add a beta plugin for testing and enter Darkildo/tropa

summary: Concept-map builder that turns notes into a dependency graph of concepts and materials and routes learning toward a chosen goal with spaced review.
